meta.footEn: Data snapshot: 2026-07-30 · Garmin fenix 8 via Freddy

en.c3d: level with previous night (55) · +1 vs 7-day avg (54)
en.c5d: computed from sleep, HRV, RHR, stress & recent load
en.rec: The catch-up night finally arrived. Lights out at 22:50 — the earliest bedtime in the window — and the night ran 7h 34m, 1h 12m over the 6h 22m average and the longest of the seven nights. Deep sleep nearly doubled to 107 minutes from 55, REM jumped to 141 minutes from 76 (the window high), and awake time fell to 9 minutes, the least broken night here. Score 84, Garmin's 'good' and a 12-point gain on the previous night. One marker moved the other way: HRV came in at 34, down 8 on yesterday, the lowest of the seven nights and 9 under the 43 average. RHR held at 55 for a fourth straight morning, still the window high. That split — long, deep, efficient sleep with a suppressed HRV — reads like a body clearing a backlog rather than one already recovered, and it usually needs a second good night to resolve, so tonight matters as much as last night did. Average stress was 23, the second calmest reading of the week. Readiness lands at 70, moderate. Worth noting yesterday was another unplanned rest day — Wednesday's swim intervals went untaken for the third week running — so legs have had two clear days since Tuesday's 185 kg hack squat and the squat on today's plan can go ahead as written. Hold the load at last Thursday's numbers rather than adding to it; the hack squat jump was this cycle's new stimulus and HRV at a window low is not the reading to stack a second one on. Keep bedtime near 22:50 tonight and the autonomics should follow the sleep. The chart still skips Sun 26: that evening has no record, so the seven bars run Wed 22 to Wed 29.

hr.c3d: isto kao prethodna noć (55) · +1 vs 7-dnevni prosjek (54)
hr.c5d: izračunato iz sna, HRV-a, RHR-a, stresa i opterećenja
hr.rec: Noć nadoknade je konačno došla. Gašenje svjetla u 22:50 — najranije lijeganje u prozoru — i noć je trajala 7h 34m, 1h 12m iznad prosjeka od 6h 22m i najdulja od sedam noći. Duboki san gotovo se udvostručio na 107 minuta s 55, REM je skočio na 141 minutu sa 76 (najviše u prozoru), a budnost je pala na 9 minuta — najmanje prekidana noć ovdje. Ocjena 84, Garminovo 'dobro' i 12 bodova više od prethodne noći. Jedan pokazatelj krenuo je u drugu stranu: HRV je stao na 34, −8 na jučer, najniže u sedam noći i 9 ispod prosjeka od 43. RHR se četvrto jutro zaredom drži na 55, i dalje najviši u prozoru. Ta podjela — dug, dubok i učinkovit san uz potisnut HRV — više izgleda kao tijelo koje otplaćuje dug nego kao tijelo koje je već oporavljeno, a obično treba i druga dobra noć da se to razriješi, pa je večerašnje lijeganje važno koliko i sinoćnje. Prosječni stres bio je 23, drugo najmirnije očitanje u tjednu. Spremnost je 70 — umjerena. Vrijedi primijetiti da je jučer bio još jedan neplanirani dan odmora — srijedini bazenski intervali treći tjedan zaredom nisu odrađeni — pa su noge imale dva čista dana nakon utorkovog hack squata sa 185 kg i čučanj s današnjeg plana može se odraditi kako je zapisan. Zadrži teret na prošločetvrtkovim brojkama, bez dodavanja; skok na hack squatu bio je novi podražaj ovog ciklusa, a HRV na minimumu prozora nije očitanje na koje se slaže drugi. Zadrži večeras lijeganje oko 22:50 i autonomika će slijediti san. Graf i dalje preskače Ned 26: ta večer nema zapisa, pa sedam stupaca ide od Sri 22 do Sri 29.
